description: This file implements the AWCProxyContainer class and its nested DBusInterface class, which manage container lifecycle and state changes via D-Bus communication in a plugin-based system. It includes methods for starting, stopping, and monitoring container states, with synchronization and timeout handling.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle, state monitoring, and D-Bus communication for a container in a plugin system.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with configuration and D-Bus client.

methods.name: ~AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and unregistering container.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface
classes.description: Handles D-Bus communication for container state changes and notifications.

methods.name: DBusInterface
methods.description: Constructor initializing D-Bus interface with container reference.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked on container state change via D-Bus.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for the container to reach a desired state within a timeout period.
